<!-- Check existing issues and read CONTRIBUTING.md. Do not copy protected text or include private data. -->

## Writer's need

Who would benefit, and what task is currently difficult?

## Proposed change

Name the affected files and the smallest useful improvement. Explain any change to routing, taxonomy, schemas, or licensing.

## Evidence and limits

Provide sources with precise locations for substantive craft or factual claims. Distinguish evidence from your inference and note relevant cultural, language, or translation limits.

## How to verify it

Describe a brief or example that would demonstrate the improvement. Are you willing to contribute a focused pull request?
